teacher.spokenText: 你好，我是太阳！我会发光、发热。八颗行星都围着我转圈圈。

sister.spokenText: 你好，我是太阳！我会发光、发热。八颗行星都围着我转圈圈。

en-teacher.spokenText: Hello, I’m the Sun! I shine and give out warmth. Eight planets travel around me.

en-sister.spokenText: Hello, I’m the Sun! I shine and give out warmth. Eight planets travel around me.

teacher.spokenText: 我是小小的水星。我住得离太阳最近，绕太阳跑得很快！

sister.spokenText: 我是小小的水星。我住得离太阳最近，绕太阳跑得很快！

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m little Mercury. I live closest to the Sun, and I travel around it very quickly!

en-sister.spokenText: I’m little Mercury. I live closest to the Sun, and I travel around it very quickly!

teacher.spokenText: 我是金星，穿着厚厚的云衣服。我的地面非常非常热！

sister.spokenText: 我是金星，穿着厚厚的云衣服。我的地面非常非常热！

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m Venus. I wear a thick blanket of clouds. My ground is very, very hot!

en-sister.spokenText: I’m Venus. I wear a thick blanket of clouds. My ground is very, very hot!

teacher.spokenText: 我是地球！蓝蓝的是大海，绿绿的是陆地。你和家人就住在我身上。

sister.spokenText: 我是地球！蓝蓝的是大海，绿绿的是陆地。你和家人就住在我身上。

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m Earth! My oceans are blue and my land is green. You and your family live here with me.

en-sister.spokenText: I’m Earth! My oceans are blue and my land is green. You and your family live here with me.

teacher.spokenText: 我是火星，看起来红红的。小机器人正在我的地面上探索呢！

sister.spokenText: 我是火星，看起来红红的。小机器人正在我的地面上探索呢！

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m Mars, the red planet. Little robots are exploring my ground!

en-sister.spokenText: I’m Mars, the red planet. Little robots are exploring my ground!

teacher.spokenText: 我是大大的木星。我身上有一道道条纹，还有一个大大的风暴！

sister.spokenText: 我是大大的木星。我身上有一道道条纹，还有一个大大的风暴！

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m big Jupiter. I have colourful stripes and a very big storm!

en-sister.spokenText: I’m big Jupiter. I have colourful stripes and a very big storm!

teacher.spokenText: 我是土星！我戴着漂亮的环，环里有好多冰块和小石头。

sister.spokenText: 我是土星！我戴着漂亮的环，环里有好多冰块和小石头。

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m Saturn! I wear beautiful rings made of lots of icy pieces and little rocks.

en-sister.spokenText: I’m Saturn! I wear beautiful rings made of lots of icy pieces and little rocks.

teacher.spokenText: 我是天王星，穿着蓝绿色衣服。我歪得很厉害，像躺着一样！

sister.spokenText: 我是天王星，穿着蓝绿色衣服。我歪得很厉害，像躺着一样！

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m Uranus. I’m blue-green, and I’m tilted so far over that I look as if I’m lying on my side!

en-sister.spokenText: I’m Uranus. I’m blue-green, and I’m tilted so far over that I look as if I’m lying on my side!

teacher.spokenText: 我是海王星。我离太阳最远，蓝蓝的身上刮着很大的风。

sister.spokenText: 我是海王星。我离太阳最远，蓝蓝的身上刮着很大的风。

en-teacher.spokenText: I’m Neptune. I’m the planet farthest from the Sun. I’m blue and very windy!

en-sister.spokenText: I’m Neptune. I’m the planet farthest from the Sun. I’m blue and very windy!

teacher.spokenText: 火箭喷出热热的气体，把自己向上推。我们离开地面，飞高一点！

sister.spokenText: 火箭喷出热热的气体，把自己向上推。我们离开地面，飞高一点！

en-teacher.spokenText: The rocket pushes hot gas down, which pushes the rocket up. We leave the ground and climb higher!

en-sister.spokenText: The rocket pushes hot gas down, which pushes the rocket up. We leave the ground and climb higher!

teacher.spokenText: 火箭飞高了，慢慢转弯。它开始向旁边飞，还要继续加速！

sister.spokenText: 火箭飞高了，慢慢转弯。它开始向旁边飞，还要继续加速！

en-teacher.spokenText: The rocket is higher now. It turns gently and starts flying sideways. We still need to speed up!

en-sister.spokenText: The rocket is higher now. It turns gently and starts flying sideways. We still need to speed up!

teacher.spokenText: 用完的火箭部分先分开。上面的发动机继续推，让飞船向旁边飞得越来越快！

sister.spokenText: 用完的火箭部分先分开。上面的发动机继续推，让飞船向旁边飞得越来越快！

en-teacher.spokenText: The empty part of the rocket separates. The engine above keeps pushing, so the spacecraft goes faster and faster sideways!

en-sister.spokenText: The empty part of the rocket separates. The engine above keeps pushing, so the spacecraft goes faster and faster sideways!

teacher.spokenText: 速度够啦！发动机停下来，飞船和上面的火箭分开，继续向前飞。

sister.spokenText: 速度够啦！发动机停下来，飞船和上面的火箭分开，继续向前飞。

en-teacher.spokenText: We’re fast enough now! The engine stops. The spacecraft separates from the rocket and keeps moving forwards.

en-sister.spokenText: We’re fast enough now! The engine stops. The spacecraft separates from the rocket and keeps moving forwards.

teacher.spokenText: 飞船正在绕着地球转圈圈！地球的引力一直拉着它，它也一直快快地向前飞。

sister.spokenText: 飞船正在绕着地球转圈圈！地球的引力一直拉着它，它也一直快快地向前飞。

en-teacher.spokenText: The spacecraft is travelling around Earth! Earth’s gravity keeps pulling it down, while it keeps moving forwards very fast.

en-sister.spokenText: The spacecraft is travelling around Earth! Earth’s gravity keeps pulling it down, while it keeps moving forwards very fast.

teacher.spokenText: 你好呀，小小宇航员！准备好了吗？我们一起去太空玩吧！

sister.spokenText: 你好呀，小小宇航员！准备好了吗？我们一起去太空玩吧！

en-teacher.spokenText: Hello, little astronaut! Let’s play in space together!

en-sister.spokenText: Hello, little astronaut! Let’s play in space together!

teacher.spokenText: 你看，太阳和八颗行星，正在一起转圈圈呢。点一点星球，和它打个招呼吧！

sister.spokenText: 你看，太阳和八颗行星，正在一起转圈圈呢。点一点星球，和它打个招呼吧！

en-teacher.spokenText: The Sun and eight planets are travelling together. Tap a planet and say hello!

en-sister.spokenText: The Sun and eight planets are travelling together. Tap a planet and say hello!

teacher.spokenText: 我们和小火箭一起出发吧！先向上飞，再向旁边加速。

sister.spokenText: 我们和小火箭一起出发吧！先向上飞，再向旁边加速。

en-teacher.spokenText: Let’s go with our little rocket! First fly up, then speed up sideways.

en-sister.spokenText: Let’s go with our little rocket! First fly up, then speed up sideways.

teacher.spokenText: 我们要去地球的身边，绕着地球转圈圈。准备好了，就点下面的大按钮，让火箭出发吧！

sister.spokenText: 我们要去地球的身边，绕着地球转圈圈。准备好了，就点下面的大按钮，让火箭出发吧！

en-teacher.spokenText: We’re going to fly around the Earth! Tap the big button below to launch our rocket.

en-sister.spokenText: We’re going to fly around the Earth! Tap the big button below to launch our rocket.

teacher.spokenText: 准备好啦，小火箭马上就要出发了！

sister.spokenText: 准备好啦，小火箭马上就要出发了！

en-teacher.spokenText: Ready! Our little rocket will launch very soon.

en-sister.spokenText: Ready! Our little rocket will launch very soon.

teacher.spokenText: 三！二！一！出发！

sister.spokenText: 三！二！一！出发！

en-teacher.spokenText: Three, two, one, lift-off!

en-sister.spokenText: Three, two, one, lift-off!
